@I80Will & @IllinoisDOT advised w/b I80, between Richards St & Wheeler Ave, will have lane closures starting 5/29. Travel delays anticipated; local Joliet traffic may be affected. Consider alternative routes. Details below.

data.raw_text: Some Filipino citizens held a protest rally outside the Japanese Embassy in the Philippines on May 26th. ⚠🚘 TRAFFIC ADVISORY

Please be advised that initial sewer line work will be completed on Greenwood Drive between Thursday, May 28 to Monday, June 1,  weather permitting.

The project will connect the sewer lines from the Greenwood Drive residential development to the main line. A portion of Greenwood Drive will be reduced to one lane during construction, with traffic personnel on-site.

Motorists are asked to respect and obey traffic personnel, as well as to consider alternate routes to avoid possible delays.

#Summerside
